page.overview:
What is Ut'Ulls-Hr'Her?

Ut'Ulls-Hr'Her is a Great Old One in the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. The character was originally created by Joseph S. Pulver for his novel Nightmare's Disciple.

Ut'Ulls-Hr'Her takes the form of a huge faceless creature with various appendages sprouting from her head, a beard of oozing horns, many reddish teats, and fish-like fins sprouting from an egg-shaped body.

Ut'Ulls-Hr'Her's true origins are unknown, although it's been speculated that she has a connection to Shub-Niggurath, possibly being the spawn between Yig and Shub-Niggurath (: Nightmare's Disciple) or possibly an avatar of the Outer God. Others have theorized that she may be the twin sister of Glaaki. She is known to dwell in the Cetus constellation, near the vicinity of a red giant star known as Mira (Omicron Ceti). There have been several claims of her being summoned to Earth but most of these cases remain unconfirmed. (: Malleus Monstrorum)

One manifestation of the entity lives in the caverns below Antioch (a Hellenic colony in modern-day Turkey), where she is worshiped by an all-female cult known as the Daughters of Isolation. Twice a month, they wear masks which are made of flayed human skin and wear sheer gowns. The women lure men to the Paradise of Daphne, promising that they will fulfill their most outrageous sexual desires. The orgy is a cover, and three victims are taken underground, who have been drugged, becoming unable to either speak or move while still being semi-conscious. They are both raped and flayed before being fed to Ut'Ulls-Hr'Her. (: Cthulhu Invictus)
